prompt:
LOCAL COSTUME VISUAL-HIERARCHY refinement of this exact Chinese ghost-shield guard. User wants the CHARACTER'S CLOTHING/ARMOR SUBDUED so the SHIELD is the main focal point.

LOCK THE ENTIRE SHIELD EXACTLY in design and visual strength: its current width, ghost face, cyan eyes, silver upper/lower volumetric horns, oblique blue protective body, silver edging, perspective and placement are all approved for this step. Do not resize, reshape, recolor, simplify or brighten the shield. Human face/hair/beard, head/body proportions, expression, stance, empty right hand and overall composition also stay.

SUBDUE ONLY BODY COSTUME:
- Unify chest, waist, skirt panels, arm and legs into quiet DEEP NAVY / MUTED SLATE-BLUE masses, noticeably lower contrast and a little less saturated than the shield's cobalt blue.
- Remove most bright silver clothing trim: delete large silver chevrons on the skirt hems and broad bright chest border. Replace with narrow low-contrast blue-gray seams or plain cloth edges.
- Waist buckle becomes a smaller plain dark blue-gray buckle rather than a bright silver framed square. Keep waist structure readable.
- Simplify the exposed right shoulder and bracer: one broad dark-blue shoulder shell, two large bracer planes, tiny subdued steel accents only at functional joints. No extra little bands or bright edge highlights.
- Legs/boots: quiet dark navy, one restrained blue-gray shin/knee plane, remove the eye-catching silver zigzag borders and bright toe stripes. Keep sturdy boot silhouette and planted stance.
- Reduce skirt layers to a few broad calm cloth panels; no new ornament or graphic motifs. Preserve the underlying sturdy Chinese heavy-guard silhouette; don't turn him into a featureless robe or black silhouette.
- Pale ghost-mane collar should be modestly quieter: reduce pure-white highlights to soft cool blue-gray and shorten a few spiky tips. Keep only the existing small cyan curls near face, less bright than shield eyes. Avoid a huge brilliant white bib competing with shield.
- The face remains a secondary focal point with original warm skin and simple dark beard; do not darken his face or change his identity.

Desired hierarchy: FIRST the giant ghost-face shield with cobalt blue/silver/cyan, SECOND the human face, THIRD a quiet substantial navy armored body.
Same clean project gem-icon painting, 2–3 LARGE coherent matte values, strong outside silhouette but sparse inner lines, no noise, tiny facets, realistic reflections, new props or effects. Full-body square warm ivory background, no crop, text or frames.
purpose: Subdue body costume contrast, silver trim and detail so the approved ghost-face shield becomes the main focal point.
visual_review: Body clothing/armor shifted to quieter navy/slate masses with reduced bright silver trim; shield retains stronger cobalt/silver/cyan contrast.
